Type a name that is not a tier table on the Tier tables tab and press Enter; screenshot the refusal under the field
Open Create an item and Give / take items on a student
Switch to Stained Glass and repeat
Measure the Room tables tab's height against the viewport and the smallest font size in each window (DevTools computed style)

settles_if.agrees: every window inside 768 px, no text under 11 px, the refusal under its field with the name kept
settles_if.defect: a tab or window past 768 px or text under 11 px in either theme

l1.what: The Countdowns tray's controls on a project row on Daggerheart 2.12.9
recipe: On the GM, in the console: game.drpg.patches?.() or read the patch row 'countdown-row-menu' probe (patches.mjs:592-595): present and ours both true
Make a project; open the Countdowns tray
Press + then - on the project's row once each: the bar moves by one each time and the token keeps its colour
Open the row's menu: Delete present, Reveal and Hide absent; on a countdown that is no project all three present
Delete the project from the menu: the project and its token are gone
As a player with the tray open press + on the project: nothing changes
Reload the GM with the tray open and repeat the menu check

settles_if.defect: a project row showing Reveal or Hide, a + that moves the bar twice or not at all, or a Delete that leaves the project
